reference_sql:
SELECT segment,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE year(created_at) = 2024) AS created_2024,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE year(created_at) = 2025) AS created_2025
FROM accounts
WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY segment
alternatives:
SELECT segment, "2024" AS created_2024, "2025" AS created_2025
FROM (
  -- one row per account created in 2024 or 2025
  SELECT segment, year(created_at) AS yr
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
) AS a
PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR yr IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY segment)

SELECT segment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN year(created_at) = 2024 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS created_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN year(created_at) = 2025 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS created_2025
FROM accounts
WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY segment
